description: Dog vocalization classification and meaning database
sources: Pongracz et al. (2005) - Acoustic parameters of dog barks carry emotional information
Yin & McCowan (2004) - Barking in domestic dogs: context specificity and individual identification
Faragó et al. (2010) - Dogs' expectation about signalers' body size by virtue of their growls

alert_bark.label: Alert/Alarm Bark
alert_bark.description: Sharp, rapid barking in quick succession
alert_bark.meaning: Something has caught my attention! There may be a threat. I'm warning you!
alert_bark.context: Common when doorbell rings, stranger approaches, or unusual sound/movement detected
alert_bark.predicted_behavior: Will continue barking and may move toward the stimulus. May look to owner for guidance.

excited_bark.label: Excited/Play Bark
excited_bark.description: High-pitched, short barks often in bursts with brief pauses
excited_bark.meaning: I'm so excited! Let's play! This is great!
excited_bark.context: During play, greeting favorite people, anticipating walks/treats
excited_bark.predicted_behavior: Will likely approach, may bring a toy, may do play bows or zoomies.

demand_bark.label: Demand/Attention Bark
demand_bark.description: Single barks at regular intervals, persistent and directed at a person
demand_bark.meaning: Hey! Pay attention to me! I want something!
demand_bark.context: When wanting food, attention, to go outside, or when feeling ignored
demand_bark.predicted_behavior: Will stare at owner, may paw at them, will persist until need is met.

fearful_bark.label: Fear Bark
fearful_bark.description: High-pitched, often frantic barking, may break into yelps
fearful_bark.meaning: I'm scared! Something is wrong! I need help!
fearful_bark.context: During thunderstorms, fireworks, when cornered or threatened
fearful_bark.predicted_behavior: May try to flee, hide, or if cornered may snap defensively.

aggressive_bark.label: Aggressive/Threatening Bark
aggressive_bark.description: Deep, low-pitched, continuous barking often with growling mixed in
aggressive_bark.meaning: Back off! I will protect myself and my territory!
aggressive_bark.context: Territorial defense, resource guarding, feeling cornered
aggressive_bark.predicted_behavior: May lunge, snap, or bite if the threat doesn't retreat. Give maximum space.

lonely_bark.label: Lonely/Boredom Bark
lonely_bark.description: Monotonous barking with long pauses, often goes on for extended periods
lonely_bark.meaning: I'm alone and I don't like it. Where is everyone?
lonely_bark.context: When left alone, in kennels, separated from family
lonely_bark.predicted_behavior: May engage in destructive behavior, pacing, or eventually settle down.

whine_attention.label: Attention Whine
whine_attention.description: High-pitched, sustained whining directed at a person or object
whine_attention.meaning: I want that! Please! I really, really want it!
whine_attention.context: When seeing food being prepared, wanting to go outside, wanting attention
whine_attention.predicted_behavior: Will fixate on desired object/person, may paw, nudge, or escalate to barking.

whine_anxious.label: Anxious/Stress Whine
whine_anxious.description: High-pitched whining with trembling quality, often accompanied by pacing
whine_anxious.meaning: I'm not comfortable. Something is making me nervous.
whine_anxious.context: New environments, vet visits, separation anxiety, storms
whine_anxious.predicted_behavior: May pace, seek comfort from owner, try to hide, or exhibit displacement behaviors.

whimper_pain.label: Pain Whimper
whimper_pain.description: Sharp, short whimpers especially when moving or being touched in specific area
whimper_pain.predicted_behavior: May guard the painful area, limp, become still, or snap if pain area is touched.

growl_warning.label: Warning Growl
growl_warning.description: Low, sustained rumbling growl, body usually stiff
growl_warning.meaning: I'm uncomfortable and I want you to stop/back away. This is my final warning.
growl_warning.context: Resource guarding, personal space violation, feeling cornered
growl_warning.predicted_behavior: If warning is not heeded, may escalate to snapping or biting. RESPECT THE GROWL.

growl_play.label: Play Growl
growl_play.description: Higher-pitched, exaggerated growl during tug-of-war or wrestling play
growl_play.meaning: This is so fun! I'm playing! Grrr, I'm a tough dog! (but not really)
growl_play.context: During tug games, play wrestling, chasing games
growl_play.predicted_behavior: Will continue playing. Body will be loose and wiggly. May pause and reinitiate.

howl.label: Howl
howl.description: Long, sustained vocalization with rising and falling pitch
howl.meaning: I'm here! Can you hear me? I'm calling to my pack!
howl.context: Response to sirens/music, separation, communication with distant dogs, breed-specific
howl.predicted_behavior: Will often tilt head back, may continue if stimulus persists. Usually self-limiting.

yelp.label: Yelp
yelp.meaning: Ouch! That hurt! / You startled me!
yelp.context: Stepped on paw, sudden pain, bitten too hard during play, startled
yelp.predicted_behavior: Will likely withdraw from the stimulus. May limp or guard injured area.

sigh.label: Deep Sigh
sigh.description: Deep exhalation, often while lying down
sigh.meaning: Context-dependent: While settling = 'I'm content'. After denied something = 'Fine, I give up.'
sigh.context: Settling down for rest, after being denied something they wanted
sigh.predicted_behavior: Will likely settle down and rest. Generally indicates transition to calm state.

panting_stressed.label: Stress Panting
panting_stressed.description: Rapid, heavy panting when not hot or after exercise
panting_stressed.meaning: I'm stressed out. Something is making me very uncomfortable.
panting_stressed.context: Vet visits, car rides, storms, new scary environments
panting_stressed.predicted_behavior: May pace, drool excessively, seek escape routes, or try to hide.

no_vocalization.label: No Vocalization
no_vocalization.description: Dog is not making any sounds
no_vocalization.meaning: Relies entirely on body language for interpretation
no_vocalization.context: Normal resting state, focused attention, or silent warning (freeze)
no_vocalization.predicted_behavior: Depends entirely on body language context.
